eps.ov: Sei greets her second summer in this world. Now that the miasma is under control and she has a bit of free time to do a little exploring...
After discovering coffee, Sei decides to go to Morgenhaffen, a port city in Salutania, in her search for items or ingredients from Japan.
Sei is invited to the royal palace for the Holy Saint's official debut. On top of that, it seems like she must also attend the royal ball.
The royal palace summons Sei once again. It seems they are getting a foreign exchange student, an imperial prince from Zaidera...
Sei remains wary around the imperial prince, but after learning a bit more of his situation, she grows curious about what he's really doing in the country.
Now that Sei knows Prince Ten'yuu needs her help, she tries to think of a way to create a panacea without exposing her powers as the Holy Saint.
Now that things have settled down, a new problem is arising. It seems that everyone is trying to get the Holy Saint to marry into their family...
Sei goes to the farthest end of the kingdom, the Hawke Region, for what the royal palace believes to be her final expedition as the Holy Saint.
To combat the source of the miasma and the unusual monsters in the area, Sei and her faithful guard venture into the local mine, where a frightful danger awaits them...
It seems that Sei's duties as a Holy Saint are coming to an end with the purification of the last miasma swamp. Now Sei must start thinking about her future.
Rumors are swirling about Sei and her theater date, which has her feeling self-conscious with everyone. Can she acknowledge her own...
